rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when saying or doing something tactfully without being too direct.

example.english: I tactfully told them that the plan had to be changed.
example.traditional: 我婉轉咁同佢講，份計劃要改。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jyun2 zyun2 gam3 tung4 keoi5 gong2 fan6 gai3 waak6 jiu3 goi2

rows.note: Use this when the tactfulness lies in handling a sensitive situation in a socially appropriate way.

example.english: Even when pressed, they tactfully handled it without embarrassing anyone.
example.traditional: 就算俾人追問，佢都得體咁應對，冇令大家難堪。
example.jyutping: zau6 syun3 bei2 jan4 zeoi1 man6 keoi5 dou1 dak1 tai2 gam3 jing3 deoi3 mou5 ling6 daai6 gaa1 naan4 ham1
